messages:
Sam (docs): Hey, noticed the /v1/generate API ref shows a single JSON response example even when stream=true. That's causing users to parse incorrectly and fail on SSE.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Thanks. When stream=true we emit SSE (Content-Type: text/event-stream) with events named 'partial' and 'done'. Each data: line is JSON with keys 'text' and 'delta'. Docs should show an SSE curl example + a non-streaming example (stream=false).

Maria (eng-ml): Please add a one-line migration note: if you parsed the whole body as JSON, switch to consuming SSE events or set stream=false to get a single JSON response.

Sam (docs): I'll open a small PR replacing the incorrect example with: 1) curl Accept: text/event-stream sample, 2) minimal SSE payload block (two partials + done), 3) curl example with stream=false returning JSON, 4) one-line migration note and a short troubleshooting tip about trimming 'data:' lines.

docs-bot: PR created by Sam (docs) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1967 assigned to Jordan (eng-runtime) for review.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Reviewing. I'll add a tiny test to assert event names and presence of 'text'/'delta' in data. Will comment on the PR shortly.

Sam (docs): Thanks — will update PR with the migration blurb and SDK micro-snippets after your review.

Jordan (eng-runtime): LGTM after test link.
